summary: Data cleaning, pipeline automation, exploratory analysis, and cross-functional reporting.
achievements: Data Cleaning & Pipeline Automation: Engineered and maintained automated data extraction, cleaning, and validation pipelines using Python and SQL, reducing manual processing overhead and ensuring high data integrity across enterprise datasets.

Exploratory Data Analysis & Analytics: Conducted in-depth exploratory data analysis (EDA) and performance tracking; created interactive Tableau and BI dashboards to visualize key operational KPIs and metrics.

Feature Engineering & Preprocessing: Applied statistical normalization, outlier treatment, and data wrangling techniques to prepare structured raw inputs for analytical modeling and downstream reporting.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnered with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical data schemas, actionable metric dashboards, and automated reporting systems.
